1937, January
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO.6.
Page 161 Cont.
Jan. 8 Gus Byrme - 51 - cancer of stoma. Operated on in March '34 in Ann Arbor - Prayers were asked for him at that time on his way to hospital. They took about 2/3 of the stomach out and he has had no trouble there-after. However, this last Xmas time there was symptons of the old trouble coming again.
Felician Community and court case - To-morrow ....
Maurice Gheran - 23 - Enrolled for T.B. when hopeless in Hamilton .. next day folks here gets telegram he's out of danger ..
Page 162
Jan. 10 Colman John Meres - 48 - Cancer of tongue - cancer
11 Rosa Simon - 50 - "Evanglish", serious Eye trouble - hardening of eye-balls - hopes to avoid necessity of further operation. Wm. Sheff - something like rhumatism
12 Ada P. Baker - 68 - groth under ear - threatening thing
12 Joseph Doyle - 65 - dying as believed Saturday last .... Sunday tak- ing nourishment. Tuesday wife phoned .. "two glasses of milk and soup- 28th" No more operation necessary - Expected home soon.
Bancher Brothers ...... one lost his property then his wife, then his memory - now in Eloise - wonders why wife never comes to visit him.
13 Patrick Donald McEvoy - 3 weeks old - born to parents only child after prayer 17 yrs. for a family. Thank: Parents were enrolled a year ago for that intention.
Hattie Jacobs.
Page 163 Jan. 18 Ronald S. 0'Neill - 40 - of Munsey, Inc. - has wife and 4 beautiful children. Alas drinks - wants to do better ... asks prayers.
19 Lawrence Irvine - 74 ... like spells .. of unconsciousness .... Enroll two weeks ago - better since .... Enrolled again To-day $5.00
21 Marion White trained nurse - 28 - given up by specialists as hopeless as % wire from Brooklyn, N. Y .... Enrolled To-night at 7:50P.M. - Jan. 27th Improving now - Drs. think it miracle .....
